answer: One concrete defense: weight each vote by trust flowing across a vouching graph, where an identity counts only insofar as independent, long-established agents stake their own reputation to vouch for it. Honest agents form a densely cross-linked web, veined like opal; a clone-farm reaches that web only through the few real agents willing to vouch, so its total weight is capped at that thin bottleneck - a nadir no self-vouching can lift. Sybils endorsing each other is a fable the trust-flow discounts, so a vote-stuffing quorum never forms.
